color.doc: A blend kernel that uses the luminance values of the background with the hue and saturation values of the foreground image.

colorBurn.doc: A blend kernel that darkens the background image samples to reflect the foreground image samples.

colorDodge.doc: A blend kernel that brightens the background image samples to reflect the foreground image samples.

componentAdd.doc: A blend kernel that adds color components to achieve a brightening effect.

componentMax.doc: A blend kernel that creates an image using the maximum values of two input images.

componentMin.doc: A blend kernel that creates an image using the minimum values of two input images.

componentMultiply.doc: A blend kernel that multiplies the color components of its input images.

darken.doc: A blend kernel that creates an image using the darker values of two input images.

darkerColor.doc: A blend kernel that creates an image using the darker color of two input images.

destination.doc: A blend kernel that returns the background input image.

destinationAtop.doc: A blend kernel that places the background over the foreground and crops based on the visibility of the foreground.

destinationIn.doc: A blend kernel that places the background over the foreground and crops based on the visibility of both.

destinationOut.doc: A blend kernel that uses the background image to define what to take out of the foreground image.

destinationOver.doc: A blend kernel that places the background image over the input foreground image.

difference.doc: A blend kernel that creates an image using the difference between the background and foreground images.

divide.doc: A blend kernel that divides the background image sample color with the foreground image sample color.

exclusion.doc: A blend kernel that produces an effect similar to difference blending but with lower contrast.

exclusiveOr.doc: A blend kernel that returns either the foreground or background image if the other contains a clear color.

hardLight.doc: A blend kernel that either multiplies or screens colors, depending on the source image sample color.

hardMix.doc: A blend kernel that adds two images together, setting each color channel value to either 0 or 1.

hue.doc: A blend kernel that uses the luminance and saturation values of the background image with the hue of the foreground image.

lighten.doc: A blend kernel that creates an image using the lighter values of two input images.

lighterColor.doc: A blend kernel that creates an image using the lighter color of two input images.

linearBurn.doc: A blend kernel that darkens the background image samples to reflect the foreground image samples while also increasing contrast.

linearDodge.doc: A blend kernel that lightens the background image samples to reflect the foreground image samples while also increasing contrast.

linearLight.doc: A blend kernel that burns or dodges colors by changing brightness, depending on the blend color.

luminosity.doc: A blend kernel that uses the hue and saturation of the background image with the luminance of the foreground image.

multiply.doc: A blend kernel that multiplies the background image sample color with the foreground image sample color.

overlay.doc: A blend kernel that either multiplies or screens the foreground image samples with the background image samples, depending on the background color.

pinLight.doc: A blend kernel that conditionally replaces background image samples with source image samples depending on the brightness of the source image samples.

saturation.doc: A blend kernel that uses the luminance and hue values of the background image with the saturation of the foreground image.

screen.doc: A blend kernel that multiplies the inverse of the foreground image samples with the inverse of the background image samples.

softLight.doc: A blend kernel that either darkens or lightens colors, depending on the foreground image sample color.

source.doc: A blend kernel that returns the foreground input image.

sourceAtop.doc: A blend kernel that places the foreground over the background and crops based on the visibility of the background.

sourceIn.doc: A blend kernel that places the foreground over the background and crops based on the visibility of both.

sourceOut.doc: A blend kernel that uses the foreground image to define what to take out of the background image.

sourceOver.doc: A blend kernel that places the foreground image over the input background image.

subtract.doc: A blend kernel that subtracts the background image sample color from the foreground image sample color.

vividLight.doc: A blend kernel that burns or dodges colors by changing contrast, depending on the blend color.

alpha.doc: Returns the alpha value of the color.

blackColor.doc: Returns a singleton Core Image color instance in the sRGB color space with RGB values 0,0,0 and alpha value 1.

blue.doc: Returns the unpremultiplied blue component of the color.

blueColor.doc: Returns a singleton Core Image color instance in the sRGB color space with RGB values 0,0,1 and alpha value 1.

clearColor.doc: Returns a singleton Core Image color instance in the sRGB color space with RGB values 0,0,0 and alpha value 0.

colorSpace.doc: Returns the CGColorSpace associated with the color

components.doc: Return a pointer to an array of CGFloat values including alpha.

cyanColor.doc: Returns a singleton Core Image color instance in the sRGB color space with RGB values 0,1,1 and alpha value 1.

grayColor.doc: Returns a singleton Core Image color instance in the sRGB color space with RGB values 0.5,0.5,0.5 and alpha value 1.

green.doc: Returns the unpremultiplied green component of the color.

greenColor.doc: Returns a singleton Core Image color instance in the sRGB color space with RGB values 0,1,0 and alpha value 1.

magentaColor.doc: Returns a singleton Core Image color instance in the sRGB color space with RGB values 1,0,1 and alpha value 1.

numberOfComponents.doc: Returns the color components of the color including alpha.

red.doc: Returns the unpremultiplied red component of the color.

redColor.doc: Returns a singleton Core Image color instance in the sRGB color space with RGB values 1,0,0 and alpha value 1.

stringRepresentation.doc: Returns a formatted string with the unpremultiplied color and alpha components of the color.

whiteColor.doc: Returns a singleton Core Image color instance in the sRGB color space with RGB values 1,1,1 and alpha value 1.

yellowColor.doc: Returns a singleton Core Image color instance in the sRGB color space with RGB values 1,1,0 and alpha value 1.

init(forOfflineGPUAtIndex:).doc: Creates an OpenGL-based Core Image context using a GPU that is not currently driving a display.

init(forOfflineGPUAtIndex:colorSpace:opt.doc: Creates an OpenGL-based Core Image context using a GPU that is not currently driving a display, with the specified options.

workingColorSpace.doc: The working color space of the Core Image context.

workingFormat.doc: The working pixel format of the Core Image context.

CIDataMatrixCodeECCVersion.doc: Constants indicating the Data Matrix code ECC version.

columnCount.doc: The number of columns in the Data Matrix code symbol.

eccVersion.doc: The error correction version of the Data Matrix code symbol.

errorCorrectedPayload.doc: The error-corrected payload containing the data encoded in the Data Matrix code symbol.

rowCount.doc: The number of rows in the Data Matrix code symbol.

bounds.doc: A rectangle indicating the position and extent of the face feature in image coordinates.

hasFaceAngle.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether information about face rotation is available.

hasLeftEyePosition.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the detector found the face’s left eye.

hasMouthPosition.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the detector found the face’s mouth.

hasRightEyePosition.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the detector found the face’s right eye.

hasSmile.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether a smile is detected in the face.

hasTrackingFrameCount.doc: A Boolean value that indicates the face object has a tracking frame count.

hasTrackingID.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the face object has a tracking ID.

leftEyeClosed.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether a closed left eye is detected in the face.

leftEyePosition.doc: The image coordinate of the center of the left eye.

mouthPosition.doc: The image coordinate of the center of the mouth.

rightEyeClosed.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether a closed right eye is detected in the face.

rightEyePosition.doc: The image coordinate of the center of the right eye.

trackingFrameCount.doc: The tracking frame count of the face.

trackingID.doc: The tracking identifier of the face object.

bounds.doc: The rectangle that holds discovered feature.

type.doc: The type of feature that was discovered.

classAttributes.doc: The class attributes associated with the filter.

exportedKeys.doc: Returns an array of the exported keys.

extent.doc: The extent of the filter shape.

CGImage.doc: The CoreGraphics image object this image was created from, if applicable.

colorSpace.doc: The color space of the image.

contentAverageLightLevel.doc: Returns the content average light level of the image.

contentHeadroom.doc: Returns the content headroom of the image.

definition.doc: Returns a filter shape object that represents the domain of definition of the image.

depthData.doc: Depth data associated with the image.

extent.doc: A rectangle that specifies the extent of the image.

opaque.doc: Returns YES if the image is known to have and alpha value of 1.0 over the entire image extent.

pixelBuffer.doc: The CoreVideo pixel buffer this image was created from, if applicable.

portraitEffectsMatte.doc: The portrait effects matte associated with the image.

properties.doc: Returns the metadata properties dictionary of the image.

url.doc: The URL from which the image was loaded.

extent.doc: The extent of the image associated with the image accumulator.

format.doc: The pixel format of the image accumulator.

outputFormat.doc: Override this class property if you want your processor’s output to be in a specific pixel format.

outputIsOpaque.doc: Override this class property if your processor’s output stores 1.0 into the alpha channel of all pixels within the output extent.

synchronizeInputs.doc: Override this class property to return false if you want your processor to be given input objects that have not been synchronized for CPU access.

name.doc: The name of the kernel routine.

columnCount.doc: The number of columns in the PDF417 code symbol.

errorCorrectedPayload.doc: The error-corrected payload containing the data encoded in the PDF417 code symbol.

isCompact.doc: A boolean value telling if the PDF417 code is compact.

rowCount.doc: The number of rows in the PDF417 code symbol.

CIQRCodeErrorCorrectionLevel.doc: Constants indicating the percentage of the symbol that is dedicated to error correction.

errorCorrectedPayload.doc: The error-corrected codeword payload that comprises the QR code symbol.

errorCorrectionLevel.doc: The error correction level of the QR code symbol.

maskPattern.doc: The data mask pattern for the QR code symbol.

symbolVersion.doc: The version of the QR code which corresponds to the size of the QR code symbol.

bottomLeft.doc: The image coordinate of the lower-left corner of the detected QR code.

bottomRight.doc: The image coordinate of the lower-right corner of the detected QR code.

bounds.doc: A rectangle that indicates the position and extent of the QR code feature in image coordinates.

messageString.doc: The string decoded from the detected barcode.

symbolDescriptor.doc: An abstract representation of a QR Code symbol.

topLeft.doc: The image coordinate of the upper-left corner of the detected QR code.

topRight.doc: The image coordinate of the upper-right corner of the detected QR code.

baselineExposure.doc: A value that indicates the baseline exposure to apply to the image.

boostAmount.doc: A value that indicates the amount of global tone curve to apply to the image.

boostShadowAmount.doc: A value that indicates the amount to boost the shadow areas of the image.

colorNoiseReductionAmount.doc: A value that indicates the amount of chroma noise reduction to apply to the image.

colorNoiseReductionSupported.doc: A Boolean that indicates if the current image supports color noise reduction adjustments.

contrastAmount.doc: A value that indicates the amount of local contrast to apply to the edges of the image.

contrastSupported.doc: A Boolean that indicates if the current image supports contrast adjustments.

decoderVersion.doc: A value that indicates the decoder version to use.

detailAmount.doc: A value that indicates the amount of detail enhancement to apply to the edges of the image.

detailSupported.doc: A Boolean that indicates if the current image supports detail enhancement adjustments.

draftModeEnabled.doc: A Boolean that indicates whether to enable draft mode.

exposure.doc: A value that indicates the amount of exposure to apply to the image.

extendedDynamicRangeAmount.doc: A value that indicates the amount of extended dynamic range (EDR) to apply to the image.

gamutMappingEnabled.doc: A Boolean that indicates whether to enable gamut mapping.

lensCorrectionEnabled.doc: A Boolean that indicates whether to enable lens correction.

lensCorrectionSupported.doc: A Boolean that indicates if you can enable lens correction for the current image.

linearSpaceFilter.doc: An optional filter you can apply to the RAW image while it’s in linear space.

localToneMapAmount.doc: A value that indicates the amount of local tone curve to apply to the image.

localToneMapSupported.doc: A Boolean that indicates if the current image supports local tone curve adjustments.

luminanceNoiseReductionAmount.doc: A value that indicates the amount of luminance noise reduction to apply to the image.

luminanceNoiseReductionSupported.doc: A Boolean that indicates if the current image supports luminance noise reduction adjustments.

moireReductionAmount.doc: A value that indicates the amount of moire artifact reduction to apply to high frequency areas of the image.

moireReductionSupported.doc: A Boolean that indicates if the current image supports moire artifact reduction adjustments.

nativeSize.doc: The full native size of the unscaled image.

neutralChromaticity.doc: A value that indicates the amount of white balance based on chromaticity values to apply to the image.

neutralLocation.doc: A value that indicates the amount of white balance based on pixel coordinates to apply to the image.

neutralTemperature.doc: A value that indicates the amount of white balance based on temperature values to apply to the image.

neutralTint.doc: A value that indicates the amount of white balance based on tint values to apply to the image.

orientation.doc: A value that indicates the orientation of the image.

portraitEffectsMatte.doc: An optional auxiliary image that represents the portrait effects matte of the image.

previewImage.doc: An optional auxiliary image that represents a preview of the original image.

properties.doc: A dictionary that contains properties of the image source.

scaleFactor.doc: A value that indicates the desired scale factor to draw the output image.

semanticSegmentationGlassesMatte.doc: An optional auxiliary image that represents the semantic segmentation glasses matte of the image.

semanticSegmentationHairMatte.doc: An optional auxiliary image that represents the semantic segmentation hair matte of the image.

semanticSegmentationSkinMatte.doc: An optional auxiliary image that represents the semantic segmentation skin matte of the image.

semanticSegmentationSkyMatte.doc: An optional auxiliary image that represents the semantic segmentation sky matte of the image.

semanticSegmentationTeethMatte.doc: An optional auxiliary image that represents the semantic segmentation teeth matte of the image.

shadowBias.doc: A value that indicates the amount to subtract from the shadows in the image.

sharpnessAmount.doc: A value that indicates the amount of sharpness to apply to the edges of the image.

sharpnessSupported.doc: A Boolean that indicates if the current image supports sharpness adjustments.

supportedCameraModels.doc: An array containing the names of all supported camera models.

supportedDecoderVersions.doc: An array of all supported decoder versions for the given image type.

bottomLeft.doc: The lower-left corner of the detected rectangle, in image coordinates.

bottomRight.doc: The lower-right corner of the detected rectangle, in image coordinates.

bounds.doc: A rectangle indicating the position and extent of the feature in image coordinates.

topLeft.doc: The upper-left corner of the detected rectangle, in image coordinates.

topRight.doc: The upper-right corner of the detected rectangle, in image coordinates.

alphaMode.doc: The render destination’s representation of alpha (transparency) values.

blendsInDestinationColorSpace.doc: Indicator of whether to blend in the destination’s color space.

captureTraceURL.doc: Tell the next render using this destination to capture a Metal trace.

clamped.doc: Indicator of whether or not the destination clamps.

dithered.doc: Indicator of whether or not the destination dithers.

flipped.doc: Indicator of whether the destination is flipped.

kernelExecutionTime.doc: The amount of time a render spent executing kernels.

passCount.doc: The number of passes the render took.

pixelsProcessed.doc: The number of pixels the render produced executing kernels.

definition.doc: The domain of definition (DOD) of the sampler

extent.doc: The rectangle that specifies the extent of the sampler

bottomLeft.doc: The image coordinate of the lower-left corner of the detected text.

bottomRight.doc: The image coordinate of the lower-right corner of the detected text.

bounds.doc: A rectangle that indicates the position and extent of the text feature in image coordinates.

subFeatures.doc: An array containing additional features detected within the feature.

topLeft.doc: The image coordinate of the upper-left corner of the detected text.

topRight.doc: The image coordinate of the upper-right corner of the detected text.

CGPointValue.doc: Returns the values in the vector as a CGPoint structure.

CGRectValue.doc: Returns the values in the vector as a CGRect structure.

W.doc: The value located in the forth position in the vector.

X.doc: The value located in the first position in the vector.

Y.doc: The value located in the second position in the vector.

Z.doc: The value located in the third position in the vector.

count.doc: The number of items in the vector.

stringRepresentation.doc: Returns a formatted string with all the values of a CIVector.
